text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 3, "unit": "hammers", "kind": "count", "span": "3 hammers in June"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 4, "unit": "hammers", "kind": "count", "span": "4 hammers in July"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 6, "unit": "hammers", "kind": "count", "span": "6 hammers in August"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 9, "unit": "hammers", "kind": "count", "span": "9 hammers in September"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q2", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "the June-to-July increase, which is also the amount each monthly increase grows by"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q4", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "the August-to-September increase"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "October's increase, one step larger than September's"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "add October's increase to September's order"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of hammers ordered in October if the pattern continues"}, "dismissed": []}
